mentions.name: Zig GUI Toolkit (SDL3 + Vulkan)
mentions.description: A GUI toolkit written in Zig on top of SDL3 and Vulkan, with many features already implemented; a posted demo showcases interactive button widgets.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been vibe-ish coding a GUI Toolkit in Zig w/ SDL3 and Vulkan for a few months now.

It has lots of features, but I posted a demo of some fun with buttons here: https://x.com/rudedoggtweets/status/2043531378181161357
